snippet.title: Tamashika - Official Gameplay Trailer | IGN Live 2025
snippet.description:
Check out fast-paced gameplay from Tamashika in this trailer for the upcoming high-speed, high-skill corridor shooter from Lovely Planet creator Quicktequila and publisher EDGLRD. In Tamashika, players control a rogue warrior trapped in an astral plane of ever-shifting corridors. Armed with only a pistol and tantō blade, they must survive 10-minute daily runs through procedurally generated levels—blinking through walls, parrying bullets, and climbing leaderboards in a pure arcade experience. Tamashika will be available on PC via Steam.
